sector_notes: The 4 November session rebounded broadly: SPY gained 1.65%, DIA 3.10% and IWM 1.51%; XLF, XLP and XLV rose 3.51%, 3.36% and 3.06%, while XLK was flat and XLE fell 4.74%. Across 30 October–4 November, financials and consumer groups were stronger, but semiconductors and energy lagged sharply; 5 November premarket futures are divergent, with Dow futures firmer and Nasdaq futures weaker. This is selective rotation rather than a clean risk-on regime, favoring liquid financials, quality industrials, healthcare and staples while avoiding earnings gaps and extended one-session moves.
